name: airllm
one_liner: Lets a huge AI language model run on a cheap, ordinary graphics card instead of needing a rack of expensive data-center GPUs.
buyer: A small AI startup or indie developer who wants to run a large open-source model on their own cheap hardware instead of paying monthly cloud GPU bills.
business_use_cases: A startup runs a large open-source model entirely on one consumer GPU in their office instead of paying for expensive cloud inference, cutting a recurring cost.
A hardware reseller or local AI consultant sells pre-configured 'run big AI models on a single GPU' workstations to small businesses wanting on-premise AI.
A researcher or hobbyist with one gaming GPU experiments with models that would otherwise require renting a multi-GPU cloud server.

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-built 'affordable local AI' workstations bundling a consumer GPU with this software, configured and ready to run.
Consulting service helping small companies move AI inference off expensive cloud GPUs onto cheaper in-house hardware using this.

steal_this: This is infrastructure for running existing models cheaper, not a product on its own — best exploited as the backend for someone else's app, not sold directly.
